3.description: Repeatedly slaps the foe. Each hit after the second has a 10% confusion chance.

13.name: Razor Wind
13.description: super effective vs Rock. +1 priority in tailwind. High crit. keen edge boost.

14.description: A frenetic dance to uplift the fighting spirit. This sharply raises the user’s Attack stat.

15.name: Cut
15.description: Sharp Steel attack, always crits. Keen Edge boost. Field-based.

16.description: A gust of wind is whipped up by wings and launched at the target to inflict damage.

17.description: The target is struck with large, imposing wings spread wide to inflict damage.

25.description: The target is attacked by a kick launched with muscle-packed power. Striker boost.

1.name: Stench
1.desc: By releasing a stench when the Pokémon deals damage with its moves, there is a 10% chance that targets will flinch. This does not stack with moves or items that have a chance to flinch.

2.name: Drizzle
2.desc: Drizzle summons rain weather when the Pokemon enters battle, lasting 8 turns (12 with Damp Rock held). Rain boosts Water moves by 50% and cuts Fire damage by 50%. Certain moves and abilities have special interactions with rain. Cannot override primal weather conditions.

3.name: Speed Boost
3.desc: Boosts the Pokémon’s Speed stat at the end of every turn.

4.name: Battle Armor
4.desc: Incoming damage is reduced by 20% (x0.8), multiplicative with other damage reduction. Additionally, critical hits are blocked, functioning as regular hits and not activating on-crit effects like To The Bone's bleed.

5.name: Sturdy
5.desc: If the Pokémon has full HP and takes damage from a move that would knock it out in one hit, it will endure the hit with 1 HP. The Pokémon is also immune to one-hit KO moves.

6.name: Damp
6.desc: If the user makes contact with another Pokemon, offensively or defensively, the other Pokemon's type is changed to pure Water. This happens immediately for multihit or priority moves and can remove STAB in the middle of an enemy's multihit move.

7.name: Limber
7.desc: All recoil damage to the user is halved; this includes moves with scaling recoil damage like Brave Bird, moves with crash damage like Jump Kick, or moves with fixed recoil like Steel Beam. Paralysis also cannot affect the user, and if they gain Limber, existing paralysis is cured.

8.name: Sand Veil
8.desc: During sandstorm, enemy Pokemon's accuracy is divided by 1.25, and user is immune to sand damage. Bypassed by No Guard/Mold Breaker.

9.name: static.name

10.name: Volt Absorb

11.name: Water Absorb
11.desc: Water-type moves do not work on the Pokémon. Instead, they restore ¼ of its max HP.

12.desc: Prevents infatuation, Taunt, and Intimidate. Contact attacks have a 20% chance to confuse.

14.name: Compound Eyes

15.name: Insomnia
15.desc: Prevents sleep and casts Torment on the opposing Pokemon on entry.

16.name: Color Change
16.desc: Transforms the user into the best defensive type before taking damage. Prioritizes immunities over resistances. Only changes to a pure type. Once per turn.

17.name: Immunity
17.desc: Prevents poisoning. Reduces all Poison-type damage by 50%. Multiplicative with other sources of damage reduction. If poisoned when gaining this ability, the poison is immediately cured.

18.name: Flash Fire
18.desc: If hit by a Fire-type move, the Pokémon absorbs the flames and uses them to power up its own Fire-type moves by 50%.

19.name: Shield Dust
19.desc: Blocks all secondary effects from damaging moves. Grants immunity to entry hazards. Blocks all powder moves including Sleep Powder, Stun Spore, Poison Powder, Spore, Cotton Spore, Rage Powder, Powder, and Magic Powder.

20.name: Own Tempo
20.desc: Grants immunity to confusion, Intimidate, and Scare. Immediately cures confusion when receiving this ability.

21.name: Suction Cups

22.name: Intimidate
22.desc: Lowers adjacent foes' Attack on entry; each successful drop has a 10% chance to inflict Fear.

23.name: Shadow Tag

24.name: Rough Skin

61.name: Shed Skin
61.desc: May cure status at the end of each turn. Shed Tail costs 1/3 of maximum HP.

62.name: Guts
62.desc: The Pokémon is so gutsy that when it has a status condition, its Attack stat is boosted by 50%. Being burned does not halve the damage dealt by the Pokémon’s physical moves.

63.name: Marvel Scale
63.desc: Raises Defense by 1.5x while statused and prevents damage from status conditions.

64.name: Liquid Ooze
64.desc: The strong stench of the Pokémon’s oozed liquid damages attackers that use HP-draining moves instead of healing them.

65.name: Overgrow
65.desc: Boosts the power of Grass-type moves by 20%, or by 50% at 1/3 HP or lower.

66.name: Blaze
66.desc: Boosts the power of Fire-type moves by 20%, or by 50% at 1/3 HP or lower.

67.name: Torrent
67.desc: Boosts the power of Water-type moves by 20%, or by 50% at 1/3 HP or lower.

68.name: Swarm
68.desc: Boosts the power of Bug-type moves by 20%, or by 50% at 1/3 HP or lower.

69.name: Rock Head
69.desc: The Pokémon will not lose HP due to recoil damage from its moves.

70.name: Drought
70.desc: Summons harsh sunlight for 8 turns (12 with Heat Rock) on entry. Boosts Fire moves by 50%, reduces Water moves by 50%. Activates extra effects on sun related moves.

71.name: Arena Trap
71.desc: Prevents all non-levitating or Ghost-type foes from switching out. Pokemon holding Shed Shell or using a pivot move such as Flip Turn can escape. Activates during the next turn if the user switches in mid battle

72.name: Vital Spirit
72.desc: Immune to sleep. When the Pokemon uses a Fighting-type move, it heals all status conditions immediately after the move resolves. Removes sleep when gained.

73.name: White Smoke
73.desc: Prevents stat reductions and sets Mist on the holder's side for 3 turns on entry.

74.name: Pure Power
74.desc: Increases the user's Attack stat by 2x. Multiplicative with other damage boosts.

75.name: Shell Armor
75.desc: Incoming damage is reduced by 20% (x0.8), multiplicative with other damage reduction. Additionally, critical hits are blocked, functioning as regular hits and not activating on-crit effects like To The Bone's bleed.

76.name: Air Lock
76.desc: Sets Tailwind for 3 turns and clears all weather effects on entry. Primal weathers are suppressed. Weather can still be set while the user is on the field, but will have no effect until the user switches.

77.name: Tangled Feet
77.desc: When the user is confused or enraged, the Pokemon uses its Speed stat instead of Defense or Special Defense for damage calculations. Choice Scarf does not affect this ability.

78.name: Motor Drive
78.desc: The Pokémon takes no damage when hit by Electric-type moves. Instead, its Speed stat is boosted.

79.name: Rivalry
79.desc: Boosts the user's damage by 25% against same-gender Pokemon and reduces damage taken by 25% from opposite-gender Pokemon. No effect with genderless Pokemon.

80.name: Steadfast
80.desc: Raises Speed when flinched. Grants paralysis immunity, immunity to self-inflicted stat drops, and halves recoil damage.

81.name: Snow Cloak
81.desc: During hail or snow, creates and maintains Aurora Veil until the weather ends or the holder leaves the field.

82.name: Gluttony
82.desc: Uses berries early. Contact attacks have a 30% chance to steal a berry.

83.name: Anger Point
83.desc: When hit, raises the user's Attack by 1 stage or maximizes it on critical hits. Activates on each hit of a multihit move.

84.name: Unburden
84.desc: Boosts Speed by 1.2x while active and prevents every Speed-lowering effect, including paralysis and held items.

85.name: Heatproof
85.desc: Halves damage from Fire-type moves. Immune to burn damage and Attack drops from burn status.

86.name: Simple
86.desc: Doubles the effects of the Pokémon’s stat changes.

87.name: Dry Skin
87.desc: Restores ¼ of the Pokémon’s max HP when hit by Water-type moves or ⅛ of the its max HP at the end of every turn in rain. However, the Pokémon receives 25% more damage from Fire-type moves and loses ⅛ of its max HP at the end of every turn in harsh sunlight.

88.name: Download
88.desc: The Pokémon compares an opposing Pokémon’s Defense and Sp. Def stats before raising its own Attack or Sp. Atk stat — whichever will be more effective.

89.name: Iron Fist
89.desc: Boosts the power of punching moves by 30%.

90.name: Poison Heal
90.desc: If poisoned or badly poisoned, the Pokémon has ⅛ of its max HP restored at the end of every turn instead of losing HP.

91.name: Adaptability
91.desc: Boosts the power of moves of the same type as the Pokémon by 100% instead of 50%. Does not stack with the Stellar-type Tera boost.

92.name: Skill Link
92.desc: The Pokémon’s multistrike moves always hit the max amount of times.

93.name: Hydration
93.desc: Cures the Pokémon’s status conditions at the end of every turn in rain.

94.name: Solar Power
94.desc: Boosts the Pokemon's highest attacking stat by 50% during sun.

95.name: Quick Feet
95.desc: When the Pokémon has a status condition, its Speed stat is boosted by 50%. Being paralyzed does not lower the Pokémon’s Speed stat.

96.name: Normalize
96.desc: Converts all damaging moves to Normal-type and grants a 10% power boost. Normal-type moves bypass resistances, but not immunities.

97.name: Sniper
97.desc: Boosts the power of the Pokémon’s critical hits by 125% instead of 50%.

98.name: Magic Guard
98.desc: The Pokémon takes damage only from attacks.

99.name: No Guard
99.desc: The Pokémon employs no-guard tactics to ensure incoming and outgoing attacks always land. If this Pokémon is your lead into battle, it raises the likelihood of double battles.

100.name: Stall
100.desc: Reduces damage by 30% if the user has not moved yet. Multiplicative with other damage reduction sources. Works when the user switches in mid-turn.

101.name: Technician
101.desc: Boosts moves with 60 BP or less by 1.5x. Does not boost moves with 60 BP or less if they potentially can have more than 60 BP, such as Revenge or Venoshock.

102.name: Leaf Guard
102.desc: During sun, cures all status conditions at the end of the turn.

103.name: Klutz (N)
103.desc: The Pokemon cannot use held items. It also prevents opposing Pokemon from consuming Berries or other held items.

104.name: Mold Breaker
104.desc: The Pokémon’s moves are unaffected by the Ability of the target, with certain exceptions.

105.name: Super Luck
105.desc: Adds +1 to the critical hit stage of all the Pokemon's damaging moves.

106.name: Aftermath
106.desc: Uses a 100 BP Explosion or Outburst (whichever is higher) when knocked out. Using explosion moves will always Flinch the target.

107.name: Anticipation
107.desc: Alerts the Pokemon when facing opponents with super-effective moves on switch-in. Dodge the first super effective hit received in battle.

108.name: Forewarn
108.desc: Reveals an opposing move and treats attacks as not very effective for the first two turns once per battle.

109.name: Unaware
109.desc: The Pokémon ignores the target’s stat changes when attacking, and ignores the attacker’s stat changes when being attacked. It cannot ignore changes to the Speed stat, however.

110.name: Tinted Lens
110.desc: The Pokémon’s "not very effective" attacks deal double damage.

111.name: Filter
111.desc: Reduces damage from super- effective attacks by 35%. Multiplicative with other sources of damage reduction.

112.name: Slow Start
112.desc: Halves Attack, Special Attack, and Speed for the first 5 turns after switching in. The turn counter resets each time the Pokemon switches out.

113.name: Scrappy
113.desc: The user can land Normal and Fighting-type moves on Ghost- types for neutral damage. Grants immunity to Intimidate and Scare.

114.name: Storm Drain
114.desc: The user draws in Water-type moves and gains immunity to them. Additionally, Water-type moves boost the highest attacking stat of the user by one stage.

115.name: Ice Body
115.desc: Prevents hail damage, restores HP during hail or snow, and contact attackers have a 10% chance to be frostbitten.

116.name: Solid Rock
116.desc: Reduces damage from super- effective attacks by 35%. Multiplicative with other sources of damage reduction.

117.name: Snow Warning
117.desc: Summons hailstorm for 8 turns (12 with Icy Rock) on entry. Damages non-Ice types by 1/16 HP per turn. Boosts the Defense stat of Ice-type Pokemon by 50%. Halves the effectiveness of sun related moves.

118.name: Honey Gather
118.desc: The Pokémon gathers Honey which is then sold for money after a battle is won, even if it did not participate.

119.name: Frisk
119.desc: Upon entering battle, reveals the opponents' items and prevents them from working for 2 turns. Does not prevent Mega Stones and other similar items from working.

120.name: Reckless
120.desc: Increases the damage of moves that cause recoil by 20%. This bonus also applies when moves gain recoil through other means, such as madness or abilities.

121.name: Multitype
121.desc: Changes the Pokémon’s type to match the Plate it holds.

122.name: Flower Gift
122.desc: During sun, boost base Special Attack and Special Defense by 50% for this Pokemon and all allies.

123.name: Bad Dreams
123.desc: All sleeping opponents lose 25% of their max HP at the end of each turn.

124.name: Pickpocket
124.desc: When the Pokémon is hit by a contact move, it will steal a held item from the attacker.

125.name: Sheer Force
125.desc: Removes most beneficial secondary effects after landing attacks in exchange for a 1.3x boost. Notably prevents Life Orb recoil when using these moves. Removable effects include reducing the target's stats, increasing the user's stats, inflicting status on a target and flinching.

126.name: Contrary
126.desc: Reverses any stat changes affecting the Pokémon so that attempts to boost its stats instead lower them — and attempts to lower its stats will boost them.

127.name: Unnerve
127.desc: Unnerves opposing Pokémon and makes them unable to eat Berries.

128.name: Defiant
128.desc: When the Pokémon has any of its stats lowered by an opponent, its Attack stat is boosted sharply.

129.name: Defeatist
129.desc: Retains its offensive reductions at low HP. Once per battle, dropping to 10% HP raises Attack, Sp. Atk, and Speed by two stages.

130.name: Cursed Body
130.desc: When the Pokémon takes damage from a move, the attacker has a 30% chance to have whichever move it last used disabled for 4 turns.

131.name: Healer
131.desc: Always cures the user's and its ally's status conditions at the end of each turn.

132.name: Friend Guard
132.desc: In a double battle, the user's ally receives 50% less damage. Multiplicative with other damage reduction sources.

133.name: Weak Armor
133.desc: When hit by a contact move, raises the user's Speed by 2 stages and lowers their defense by 1 stage. Activates on each hit of a multihit move.

134.name: Heavy Metal
134.desc: Doubles weight and halves damage from Ghost, Dark, and sound-based moves.

135.name: Light Metal
135.desc: Light Metal halves the Pokemon's weight and boosts their Speed stat by 30%. Makes weight-based attacks such as Low Kick deal less damage against this Pokemon. However, it also decreases damage from the user's Heavy Slam and similar weight- based moves.

136.name: Multiscale
136.desc: Halves the damage the Pokémon takes while its HP is full.

137.name: Toxic Boost
137.desc: Increases the Pokemon's Attack stat by 50% when poisoned (regular or badly poisoned). Immediately applies poison to user when in Toxic Terrain, regardless of them being grounded or not. Nullifies poison damage.

138.name: Flare Boost
138.desc: Raises the Pokemon's Special Attack stat by 50% when burned. Negates burn damage. Immediately applies burn to self in fog.

139.name: Harvest
139.desc: If the Pokémon has used a Berry, it has a 50% chance of creating another one at the end of every turn. In harsh sunlight, the Pokémon is guaranteed to create a Berry.

140.name: Telepathy
140.desc: Protects the team from friendly fire, senses super-effective moves, dodges the first super-effective hit, and reveals one additional biome.

141.name: Moody
141.desc: At the end of every turn, one of the Pokémon’s stats will be boosted sharply, but another will be lowered. Accuracy and evasiveness are excluded.

142.name: Overcoat
142.desc: Provides immunity to weather damage from Sandstorm and Hail, and blocks all powder moves including Sleep Powder, Stun Spore, Poison Powder, Spore, Cotton Spore, Rage Powder, Powder, and Magic Powder. Also reduces incoming special damage by 20%. Multiplicative with other damage reduction sources.

143.name: Poison Touch
143.desc: Has a 30% chance to inflict poison on contact moves, both when attacking and being attacked.

144.name: Regenerator
144.desc: The Pokémon has ⅓ of its max HP restored when it switches out of battle.

145.name: Big Pecks
145.desc: Boosts the power of contact moves by 30%.

146.name: Sand Rush
146.desc: Boosts the Pokemon's Speed stat by 50% in sand. Also grants immunity to sandstorm damage.

147.name: Wonder Skin
147.desc: Immune to all damage boosting ability effects from opponents, other than Parental Bond and Multi-Headed.

148.name: Analytic
148.desc: When the user moves after the target, boosts attack power by 30%.

149.name: Illusion
149.desc: The Pokémon fools opponents by entering battle disguised as the last Pokémon in its party. It reverts to its usual appearance when it takes damage from a move.

150.name: Imposter
150.desc: Transforms into the opponent on entry; while transformed, copied attacks deal 30% more damage.

151.name: Infiltrator
151.desc: When using its moves, the Pokémon ignores the effects of targets’ Light Screen, Reflect, Aurora Veil, Safeguard, and substitutes.

152.name: Mummy
152.desc: Contact replaces the attacker's Ability with Mummy and disables its first innate until it switches. Mummy-family holders are immune.

153.name: Moxie
153.desc: When the Pokémon knocks out a target with an attack, it shows moxie, which boosts its Attack stat.

154.name: Justified
154.desc: Immune to Dark-type moves, and boost Attack by 1 stage when the user is hit by them.

155.name: Rattled
155.desc: Raises Speed when threatened by certain moves and guarantees escape from wild battles.

156.name: Magic Bounce
156.desc: Instead of being affected by other Pokémon’s status moves, the Pokémon bounces them back at the user.

157.name: Sap Sipper
157.desc: Immune to Grass-type moves, and boost highest attacking stat by 1 stage when the user is hit by them.

158.name: Prankster
158.desc: Status moves gain +1 priority. Status moves fail when directly targeting opposing Dark-type Pokemon.

159.name: Sand Force
159.desc: Boosts the Pokemon's highest attacking stat by 50% in sand. Immune to sandstorm damage.

160.name: Iron Barbs
160.desc: When the Pokémon is hit by a contact move, its iron barbs damages the attacker equal to ⅛ of their max HP.

161.name: Zen Mode
161.desc: The Pokémon changes its form to Zen Mode when its HP drops to ½ or less.

162.name: Victory Star
162.desc: Boosts the user's and their ally's accuracy by 1.2x when active in a double battle.

163.name: Turboblaze
163.desc: Allows moves to ignore the target's abilities and innates that interfere with effects or reduce damage. Does not bypass abilities that modify base stats such as Grass Pelt. Adds Fire to the user's typing. Retains Fire typing even upon losing the ability, going away only when switching out.

164.name: Teravolt
164.desc: Allows moves to ignore the target's abilities and innates that interfere with effects or reduce damage. Does not bypass abilities that modify base stats such as Grass Pelt. Adds Electric to the user's typing. Retains Electric typing even upon losing the ability, going away only when switching out.

165.name: Aroma Veil
165.desc: Protects the holder and its allies from mental effects and non-guaranteed secondary effects.

166.name: Flower Veil
166.desc: If the Pokémon or its allies next to it in battle are Grass-type, they are immune to status conditions and cannot have their stats lowered.

168.name: Protean
168.desc: Changes the Pokémon’s type to the type of the move it’s about to use.

169.name: Fur Coat
169.desc: Halves the damage the Pokémon takes from physical moves.

170.name: Magician
170.desc: The user steals the target's held item when landing a non-contact move if they are currently holding no item. Does not work with Mega Stones and other similar items.

171.name: Bulletproof
171.desc: The Pokémon is immune to ball and bomb moves.

172.name: Competitive
172.desc: When the Pokémon has any of its stats lowered by an opponent, its Sp. Atk stat is boosted sharply.

173.name: Strong Jaw
173.desc: Boosts the power of biting and fang moves by 30%.

174.name: Refrigerate
174.desc: Changes the user's Normal-type moves to Ice-type. If the user is Ice-type its Ice-type moves have a 10% frostbite chance, otherwise it gains Ice STAB.

175.name: Sweet Veil (P)
175.desc: Prevents the user and allies from falling asleep. The first time it enters battle, restores 10% of the party's maximum HP.

176.name: Stance Change
176.desc: The Pokémon changes into its Blade Forme when it attacks and changes into its Shield Forme when it uses the move King’s Shield.

177.name: Gale Wings
177.desc: Increases the priority of the Pokémon’s Flying-type moves by 1 stage while its HP is full.

178.name: Mega Launcher
178.desc: Boosts pulse, beam, ball, and aura moves by 30%.

179.name: Grass Pelt
179.desc: Boosts the Pokémon’s Defense stat by 50% on Grassy Terrain.

180.name: Symbiosis (N)
180.desc: When an ally consumes an item, the Pokémon gives its own held item to that ally.

181.name: Tough Claws
181.desc: Boosts the power of the Pokémon’s contact moves by 30%.

182.name: Pixilate
182.desc: Changes the user's Normal-type moves to Fairy-type. If the user is Fairy-type its Fairy-type moves have a 10% infatuate chance, otherwise it gains Fairy STAB.

183.name: Gooey
183.desc: When the Pokémon is hit by a contact move, the attacker’s Speed stat is lowered.

184.name: Aerilate
184.desc: Changes the user's Normal-type moves to Flying-type. If the user is Flying-type its Flying-type moves are 10% faster, otherwise it gains Flying STAB.

185.name: Parental Bond
185.desc: The Pokémon strikes twice, with the second strike dealing ¼ of the first attack’s power. Multistrike moves and moves that target multiple Pokémon are ignored.

186.name: Dark Aura
186.desc: Boosts the power of the Dark-type moves of all Pokémon on the field by 33%.

187.name: Fairy Aura
187.desc: Boosts the power of the Fairy-type moves of all Pokémon on the field by 33%.

188.name: Aura Break
188.desc: Weakens Aura moves by 25% and suppresses opposing Battle Aura and Aura Armor.

189.name: Primordial Sea
189.desc: The Pokémon changes the weather to nullify Fire-type attacks.

190.name: Desolate Land
190.desc: The Pokémon changes the weather to nullify Water-type attacks.

191.name: Delta Stream
191.desc: Summons strong winds on entry and creates Tailwind for 3 turns.

192.name: Stamina
192.desc: When hit, raises the user's Defense by 1 stage or maximizes it on critical hits. Activates on each hit of a multihit move.

193.name: Wimp Out
193.desc: Switches out below half HP and guarantees escape from wild battles.

194.name: Emergency Exit
194.desc: Switches out below half HP and guarantees escape from wild battles.

195.name: Water Compaction
195.desc: Reduces damage from Water-type moves by 50% and raises Defense by 2 stages when hit by Water moves. Multiplicative with other sources of damage reduction. Defense boost applies after the hit lands. Activates on each hit of a multihit move.

196.name: Merciless
196.desc: Guarantees critical hits against targets who are poisoned, paralyzed, bleeding, or have their speed lowered.

197.name: Shields Down
197.desc: When its HP drops to ½ or less, the Pokémon’s shell breaks and it becomes aggressive.

198.name: Stakeout
198.desc: Doubles the damage dealt to a target that has just switched into battle.

199.name: Water Bubble
199.desc: Halves the damage the Pokémon takes from Fire-type moves and doubles the power of its Water-type moves. The Pokémon cannot be burned.

200.name: Steelworker
200.desc: Changes the user's Normal-type moves to Steel-type. If the user is Steel-type it resists Ghost and Dark, otherwise it gains Steel STAB.

201.name: Berserk
201.desc: Berserk activates when the Pokemon drops to half HP or below from an opposing attack, boosting its highest attacking stat by one stage. Includes stat stages to determine which gets boosted. Triggers only once per battle. Other damage sources that bring you to half HP or below will not activate it.

202.name: Slush Rush
202.desc: Boosts the Pokemon's Speed stat by 50% during hail. Also grants immunity to hail damage.

203.name: Long Reach
203.desc: Long Reach prevents the user from making contact with targets when using contact moves. Additionally, physical moves receive a 1.2x damage boost.

204.name: Liquid Voice
204.desc: The Pokémon’s sound-based moves become Water-type moves.

205.name: Triage
205.desc: Gives priority to the Pokémon’s healing moves.

206.name: Galvanize
206.desc: Changes the user's Normal-type moves to Electric-type. If the user is Electric-type its Electric-type moves have a 10% chance to paralyze, otherwise it gains Electric STAB.

207.name: Surge Surfer
207.desc: Surge Surfer boosts the Pokemon's Speed by 50% when Electric Terrain is active. The boost applies immediately and disappears when it ends.

208.name: Schooling
208.desc: The Pokémon forms a powerful school when it reaches level 20. It stops schooling when its HP drops to ¼ or less.

209.name: Disguise
209.desc: Disguise blocks the first damaging move that hits the Pokemon and changes its form after. Only non-status moves are blocked. In fog, the disguise is restored immediately once per switch in, or when fog is set again.

210.name: Battle Bond
210.desc: Once per switch-in when the Pokémon knocks out a target, its Attack, Sp. Atk, and Speed stats are boosted. If a Greninja has this ability, it instead transforms into Ash-Greninja whenever it knocks out a target.

211.name: Power Construct
211.desc: Cells gather to aid the Pokémon when its HP drops to ½ or less, causing it to change into its Complete Forme.

212.name: Corrosion
212.desc: The Pokémon can poison or badly poison targets even if they’re Steel or Poison types.

213.name: Comatose
213.desc: The Pokémon is always drowsing and can attack while in its sleeping state. It is considered under the effects of a status condition.

214.name: Queenly Majesty
214.desc: The Pokémon’s majesty pressures opponents and makes them unable to use priority moves against the Pokémon or its allies next to it in battle.

215.name: Innards Out
215.desc: When the Pokémon takes damage from a move that knocks it out, it deals the same amount of damage to the attacker.

216.name: Dancer
216.desc: Whenever a dance move is used in battle, the Pokémon will copy the user to immediately perform that dance move itself.

217.name: Battery
217.desc: Allies next to the Pokémon in battle have their Sp. Atk increased by 30% when using special moves.

218.name: Fluffy
218.desc: Halves the damage taken from moves that make direct contact, but doubles that of Fire-type moves.

219.name: Dazzling
219.desc: Protects the user's side from priority moves and boosts accuracy by 1.2x.

220.name: Soul-Heart
220.desc: Boosts the Pokémon’s Sp. Atk stat every time another Pokémon faints.

221.name: Tangling Hair
221.desc: Contact lowers the attacker's Speed and has a 50% chance to trap it.

222.name: Receiver
222.desc: The Pokémon changes its Ability to match that of a defeated ally in a Double Battle.

223.name: Power of Alchemy
223.desc: Upon entry, transmutes all opposing Berries into Black Sludge. When any Pokemon loses an item during battle, it gets replaced by Black Sludge. If Black Sludge is removed, it gets replaced by Big Nugget.

224.name: Beast Boost
224.desc: Boosts the Pokémon’s most proficient stat every time it knocks out a target.

225.name: RKS System
225.desc: RKS System changes the user's form based on its held Memory disc. Before each attack, the user overrides their type to match the move's type. Boosts STAB from 1.5x to 2.0x damage.

226.name: Electric Surge
226.desc: Turns the ground into Electric Terrain for 5 turns when the Pokémon enters a battle.

227.name: Psychic Surge
227.desc: Creates Psychic Terrain for 8 turns (12 with Terrain Extender) on entry. Grounded Pokemon are immune to priority moves from opponents. Psychic moves gain 30% power boost. Expanding Force hits all foes with increased power. Nature Power becomes Psychic. Overrides other existing terrains.

228.name: Misty Surge
228.desc: Creates Misty Terrain on entry, lasting 8 turns (12 with Terrain Extender). Misty Terrain prevents all status conditions for grounded Pokemon and boosts Fairy-type moves by 30%. Overrides existing terrain.

229.name: Grassy Surge
229.desc: Creates Grassy Terrain for 8 turns (12 with Terrain Extender) on entry. Grounded Pokemon heal 1/16 HP per turn and Grass moves gain 30% power. Overrides other terrains.

230.name: Full Metal Body
230.desc: Full Metal Body gives immunity to all stat reductions from moves and abilities. Includes self stat drops from moves like Overheat.

231.name: Shadow Shield
231.desc: Halves the damage the Pokémon takes while its HP is full. This effect cannot be ignored by other Pokémon’s moves or Abilities.

232.name: Prism Armor
232.desc: Reduces damage from super- effective attacks by 35%. Multiplicative with other sources of damage reduction.

233.name: Neuroforce
233.desc: Super effective attacks are boosted by 35%.

234.name: Intrepid Sword
234.desc: Boosts the Pokémon’s Attack stat when the Pokémon enters a battle.

235.name: Dauntless Shield
235.desc: Boosts the Pokémon’s Defense stat when the Pokémon enters a battle.

236.name: Libero
236.desc: Changes the Pokémon’s type to the type of the move it’s about to use.

238.name: Cotton Down
238.desc: When the Pokémon is hit by an attack, it scatters cotton fluff around and lowers the Speed stat of all Pokémon except itself.

239.name: Propeller Tail
239.desc: Propeller Tail boosts the user's Speed by 50% during rain and grants immunity to redirection effects. The speed boost works in all forms of rain.

240.name: Mirror Armor
240.desc: Instead of being affected by stat-lowering effects, the Pokémon bounces them back at whichever Pokémon caused them.

241.name: Gulp Missile
241.desc: Takes 20% less damage from direct attacks.

242.name: Stalwart
242.desc: Can't have its moves redirected, can't be critically hit, and can't have its abilities suppressed. Ability suppression includes effects such as Mold Breaker, Gastro Acid, Neutralizing Gas, and Mycelium Might.

243.name: Steam Engine
243.desc: Boosts the Speed stat by 6 stages when the Pokémon is hit by a Fire- or Water-type move.

244.name: Punk Rock
244.desc: Boosts the power of the Pokémon’s sound-based moves by 30%. The Pokémon also takes half the damage from these kinds of moves

245.name: Sand Spit
245.desc: Summons a sandstorm for 5 turns when the Pokémon takes damage from moves.

246.name: Ice Scales
246.desc: The Pokémon is protected by ice scales, which halve the damage taken from special moves.

247.name: Ripen
247.desc: Ripens and doubles the effect of berries eaten by the Pokémon.

248.name: Ice Face
248.desc: The Pokémon’s ice head can take a physical attack as a substitute, the ice will be restored when it begins to snow or hail.

249.name: Power Spot
249.desc: Allies next to the Pokémon in battle deal 30% increased damage.

250.name: Mimicry
250.desc: Terrain-based moves use the higher offense. Terrain Pulse gains STAB and chooses the strongest of Psychic, Fairy, Poison, Electric, or Grass.

251.name: Screen Cleaner
251.desc: On entry, removes Reflect, Light Screen, Aurora Veil, and Smokescreen from the opposing side only.

252.name: Steely Spirit
252.desc: Steely Spirit increases the power of Steel-type moves by 30% for both the user and its allies in battle.

253.name: Perish Body
253.desc: Contact causes both battlers to perish in four turns. Also gains Aftermath.

254.name: Wandering Spirit
254.desc: When the Pokémon is hit by a contact move, it swaps Abilities with the attacker.

255.name: Gorilla Tactics
255.desc: Boosts the Pokémon’s Attack stat by 50%, but only allows the use of the first selected move.

256.name: Neutralizing Gas
256.desc: While the Pokémon is in the battle, the effects of all other Pokémon’s Abilities will be nullified or will not be triggered.

257.name: Pastel Veil
257.desc: Uses Safeguard on entry. The first time it enters battle, restores 10% of the party's maximum HP.

258.name: Hunger Switch
258.desc: The Pokémon changes its form, alternating between its Full Belly Mode and Hangry Mode after the end of every turn.

259.name: Quick Draw
259.desc: Damaging moves may act first in their priority bracket. A Quick Draw-procced attack deals double damage to another Quick Draw user.

260.name: Unseen Fist
260.desc: When the Pokémon uses contact moves, it can hit even targets that are protecting themselves, dealing ¼ of the damage that the move would otherwise deal. Everything aside from the target’s protective effects is still triggered.

261.name: Curious Medicine

5608.desc: Destroys terrain and boosts highest stat on entry.

5609.name: Greedy
5609.desc: Uses Thief when it loses an item.

5610.name: Lightsaber
5610.desc: Adds Fire-type. Keen Edge moves have 25% burn or paralysis.

5611.name: Loose Thorns
5611.desc: Sets Creeping Thorns when hit by contact.

5613.name: Laser Drill
5613.desc: Horn moves have a 50% burn chance.

5614.name: Strikeout
5614.desc: Forces the foe out if they don't attack for 3 turns.

5615.name: Home Run
5615.desc: Landing a crit boosts your 3 lowest stats once per turn.

5617.name: Narcissist
5617.desc: When a stat is lowered, sharply raise both offenses.

5618.name: Let's Dance
5618.desc: Uses Teeter Dance on entry, Confusing the field.

5623.name: Chainsaw
5623.desc: Keen edge attacks lower defense by -1.

5626.name: Mashed Potato
5626.desc: Syrup Bomb effect on the foe for 3 turns.

5628.name: Taste the Rainbow
5628.desc: Summons the Rainbow Pledge effect on entry.

5629.name: Hypnotic Touch
5629.desc: 20% chance to sleep on contact. Also works on offense.

5631.name: Wings of Pestilence
5631.desc: Every attack has a 20% Bleed chance and 10% Curse chance.

5634.name: Hammer Fist
5634.desc: Boosts punch and hammer moves by 25%.

5636.name: Raging Storm
5636.desc: Ups highest attacking stat by 1.5x in rain.

5638.name: Sumo Wrestler
5638.desc: Uses 20BP Circle Throw at the end of each 2nd turn.

5641.name: Cool Exit
5641.desc: Uses Chilly Reception at the end of your 2nd turn.

5642.name: Devious Present
5642.desc: Boosts Ice and throwing moves by 50%.

5643.name: Christmas Nightmare
5643.desc: Enemies take 1/8 damage when in hail.

5644.name: Sap Trap
5644.desc: Lowers foe's speed at the end of turns. At -3 they get trapped.

5645.name: Dead Bark
5645.desc: Adds Ghost type. Takes 15% less damage. 30% less damage if SE.

5646.name: Echolocation
5646.desc: In fog, deal 20% more damage and never miss.

5650.name: Foamy Web
5650.desc: Casts an unremovable Sticky Web on entry. Lasts 5 turns.

5651.name: Sharp Talons
5651.desc: Kicking moves have a 50% Bleed chance.

5652.name: Zen Garden
5652.desc: Sets up Grassy or Psychic Terrain at random.

5653.name: Tummyache
5653.desc: On a direct-damage faint, uses Gastro Acid on the attacker.

5654.name: Hypnotic Trance
5654.desc: Hypnosis never misses and also causes Confusion.

5655.name: Brain Overload
5655.desc: When hit, sets up Psychic Terrain.

5656.name: Brain Mass
5656.desc: Halves damage at full HP. When hit, has a 50% chance to use Drain Brain with half healing.

5658.name: Chestnut Axe
5658.desc: Keen edge + Grass moves become Keen Edge boosted.

5659.name: Giant Shuriken
5659.desc: Water Shuriken hits once with 100BP and +1 crit.

5660.name: Rain Shroud
5660.desc: Blocks priority moves and halves special damage while rain is active.

5663.name: Wrestle Showman
5663.desc: Flying Press gains +10BP and causes Taunt.

5666.name: Foggy Eye
5666.desc: While in Fog, boost Ghost moves by 50% and resist Ghost moves.

5670.name: Fire's Wrath
5670.desc: Intimidate + Scare; 10% burn chance on non contact moves.

5673.name: Break it Down
5673.desc: Follows attacks with a 20 BP Rapid Spin and also counters incoming sound moves with it.

5674.name: Talon Trap
5674.desc: 50% chance to trap on contact. 100% if entered this turn.

5675.name: Backstreet Boy
5675.desc: Striker + Kicking moves are Dance moves and vise-versa.

5676.name: Backflip
5676.desc: After using a Dance move, follow up with a 50BP Chip Away.

5677.name: Crushing Jaw
5677.desc: Strong Jaw + Biting moves have a 50% chance to lower defense.

5678.name: Eternal Flower
5678.desc: Reduces the stats of other Megas by 20%.

5680.name: Hollow Ice Zone
5680.desc: Ice-type moves apply Ice Statue and then make the user switch.

5681.name: Overcast
5681.desc: Low Visibility + Sets Mist on entry.

5683.name: Flower Necklace
5683.desc: This Pokémon's SpDef gets a 1.5x boost in Grassy Terrain.

5684.name: Mega Drill
5684.desc: Mighty Horn + all Drill moves are 30% stronger.

5685.name: Mucus Membrane
5685.desc: Takes 30% less damage from attacks + Gooey

5688.name: Storm Cloud
5688.desc: Summon rain on entry for 8 turns. Gain Electric-type STAB.

5690.name: Drakelp Head
5690.desc: Weakens the first hit received; at full HP, Dragon-type damage is also halved.

5691.name: Polarity
5691.desc: Increases the party's highest stat by 30%

5692.name: Resilience
5692.desc: Heal 1/4 of max HP whenever below 1/2 health

5694.name: Thunder Clouds
5694.desc: After using a special move, launch a 35 BP Thunderbolt

5695.name: Unrelenting
5695.desc: All attacking moves can hit 2-5 times

5696.name: Elemental Aegis
5696.desc: Takes 1/2 damage from Fire, Electric and Water-type attacks.

5697.name: Aegis Ward
5697.desc: Takes 1/2 damage from Dark, Ghost and Psychic-type attacks.

5699.name: Acid Reflux
5699.desc: Uses 20BP Acid when it takes damage.

5701.name: Survivor Bias
5701.desc: Not very effective moves can't cause fainting.

5705.name: Feathercoat
5705.desc: Takes 10% less damage from attacks, 20% if resisted.

5706.name: Power Outage
5706.desc: Boosts first Electric attack by 2x then loses Electric type.

5707.name: Electro Booster
5707.desc: Uses Ion Deluge when entering battle.

5709.name: Daredevil
5709.desc: +1 Atk after using recoil move. 1/2 recoil damage.

5710.name: Frost Dragon
5710.desc: Using an Ice-type move triggers a 40 BP Breaking Swipe follow-up.

5712.name: Sinister Claws
5712.desc: Mystic Blades + Keen Edge moves lower SpDef.

5713.name: Petal Shield
5713.desc: Maxes Def on entry. -1 Def when hit.

5715.name: Ghost Pepper
5715.desc: Grass moves have a 30% to cause burn.

5718.name: Icicle Fist
5718.desc: Iron Fist + 30% chance to cause frostbite with punches.

5720.name: Wind Chimes
5720.desc: Amplifier + attacks with 30 BP Hyper Voice when hit.

5723.name: Deflect
5723.desc: Counters with 20 BP Vacuum Wave when hit. Takes 20% less damage.

5724.name: Overwhelming Mind
5724.desc: Boosts Psychic-type moves by 1.3x, or 1.8x when below 1/3 HP.

5727.name: Foul Energy
5727.desc: Boosts Dark-type moves by 1.2x, or 1.5x when under 1/3 HP.

5728.name: Jungle Fever
5728.desc: If Grassy Terrain is active, gets a 1.5x Speed boost.

5729.name: King of the Jungle
5729.desc: Deals 50% more damage to Grass-type Pokemon, gains Infiltrator, and takes half damage from Grass-type Pokemon.

5731.name: Sleek Scales
5731.desc: The Pokémon uses +15% of its Speed when defending.

5732.name: Rock Armor
5732.desc: Rocky Exterior + takes 10% less damage from attacks.

5900.name: Silken Decree
5900.desc: At the end of each turn, randomly seals up to two opposing moves for one turn.

5901.name: Puppet Strings
5901.desc: When this Pokemon damages a poisoned foe with a Psychic-type move, that foe becomes Commanded: its next action is hijacked (it strikes an ally in doubles, or itself in singles; a status move fails). Once per foe's switch-in.

5902.name: Spore Bed
5902.desc: On entry, lays a one-use Infestation trap on the opposing side. The next grounded foe to switch in is trapped by Infestation for its ordinary duration.

5903.name: Tangled Seed
5903.desc: When this Pokemon applies Leech Seed, the seeded target cannot voluntarily switch out until the end of the following turn. Forced switches still work.

5904.name: Common Root
5904.desc: Whenever a foe loses HP to Leech Seed, every active Pokemon on this Pokemon's side recovers the ordinary Leech Seed amount, not just the seeder.

5905.name: Mycelial Network
5905.desc: Whenever a foe loses HP to Infestation, this Pokemon heals half that amount. If it is at full HP, the overflow heals its lowest-HP ally (doubles and triples only).

5906.name: Last Host
5906.desc: Once per battle, if this Pokemon would faint while a foe is affected by Infestation, it survives at 1 HP: it consumes the Infestation on the highest-HP affected foe, which then loses 25% of its max HP.

5907.name: Dandelion Burst
5907.desc: Once per battle, when this Pokemon falls to half HP or lower, it applies Leech Seed to all foes and uses Cotton Spore against the opposing side. Normal immunities apply.

5908.name: Crosscut
5908.desc: This Pokemon's single-hit slicing and pulse moves strike twice at 70% power each: once with the move's own category and once with the opposite, using the matching offense and defense. Multi-hit moves are unaffected.

5909.name: Chivalry
5909.desc: In doubles, this Pokemon takes 50% of the direct damage aimed at its ally as a raw, unmitigated hit. In singles, when it voluntarily switches out, the incoming Pokemon sends 25% of the direct damage it takes to the off-field holder until the end of its next turn.

5910.name: Borrowed Time
5910.desc: On entry, this Pokemon swaps its raw Speed with the fastest opposing Pokemon for 3 turns. Each turn, one third of the original difference returns to each side until both are back to normal.

5911.name: Relativity
5911.desc: When this Pokemon acts before its target, its damaging moves use its Speed instead of Attack or Sp. Atk. When it acts after its target, it takes 25% less damage from that target. Based on move order, not speed.

5912.name: Cleansing Light
5912.desc: For every direct KO this Pokemon scores, its lowest-HP living ally heals 10% of its max HP. A second KO in the same turn also cures that ally's status.

5913.name: Quickening Grace
5913.desc: Once per turn, the first attacking two-turn charge move selected by an ally executes immediately, skipping its charge turn. Does not affect Geomancy, status moves, or recharge moves.

5914.name: Pressure Vessel
5914.desc: This Pokemon's Defense and Sp. Def scale with its remaining PP: 1.5x at full PP across its moveset, down to 1.0x when empty (1.25x at half).

5915.name: Rain Pump
5915.desc: At the end of each turn in rain, every one of this Pokemon's moves recovers 1 PP.

5916.name: Life Preserver
5916.desc: Once per battle, when this Pokemon's ally would faint from a direct attack, the ally survives at 1 HP and the attacker becomes Drenched. Water-type attackers are unaffected.

5917.name: World in Pieces
5917.desc: This Pokemon is Normal/Rock/Ice/Steel/Electric/Dragon. The first direct hit each turn strips one non-Normal type after it lands; each missing type grants +20% Speed. Every KO it scores restores one type.

5918.name: Soulmate
5918.desc: On entry this Pokemon links to a nearby ally. 25% of the direct damage the linked ally takes is redirected to this Pokemon as raw HP, and 50% of the direct healing this Pokemon receives is copied to the linked ally.

5919.name: Rendezvous
5919.desc: On entry this Pokemon links to a nearby ally. If both linked Pokemon target the same opponent in one turn, the second move dealt gains 20% power and both restore 5% of their max HP.

5920.name: Heartbreak
5920.desc: On entry this Pokemon links to a nearby ally. When that ally faints, this Pokemon gains +1 Speed and +1 in its higher attacking stat, and loses 1 stage of Defense and Sp. Def.

5921.name: Synchronized Current
5921.desc: If this Pokemon and an allied Plus- or Minus-aligned Pokemon both damage the same target in one turn, that target is paralyzed after both attacks resolve (normal paralysis immunities apply). With any ally: if both attack in a turn, each attack gains 25% power; if neither attacks, both restore 1/4 of their max HP at the end of the turn.

5922.name: Positive Feedback
5922.desc: When this Pokemon damages a paralyzed target, it consumes the paralysis, the attack gains 25% power, and the target's higher defensive stat drops one stage.

5923.name: Negative Feedback
5923.desc: When this Pokemon damages a paralyzed target, it consumes the paralysis, gains +1 Speed, suppresses one of the target's held items until the end of the following turn, and its own next physical move becomes Electric/Fairy dual-type.

5924.name: Closed Circuit
5924.desc: If this Pokemon and an ally target the same opponent in one turn, BOTH launch an extra 25-power Electric/Fairy attack at that opponent after both moves resolve. If the target faints, a remaining extra attack carries over to another opponent.

5925.name: Capacitor Bank
5925.desc: This Pokemon builds up to 4 charges: +1 when it lands an attack, +1 when it is hit by a damaging move, and it absorbs Electric moves for +1 (redirecting them to itself in doubles). Its own Electric moves spend one charge each. Multi-hit moves grant one charge.

5926.name: Fault Current
5926.desc: Every second turn this Pokemon stays on the field, it discharges all of its charges as a spread Electric attack on all opponents, dealing 15 power per charge spent. The counter resets when it switches out.

5927.name: Overloaded
5927.desc: While at 4 charges, this Pokemon's Electric moves gain 25% power and +1 priority and it cannot switch out. If it ends a turn still at 4 charges, it loses 1/8 of its max HP.

5928.name: Library
5928.desc: The first move each opposing Pokemon uses is recorded (up to 3, newest kept). A repeated recorded move deals 15% less damage to this Pokemon's side. From the fight menu this Pokemon can cast recorded moves, twice per battle total, using its Sp. Atk.

5929.name: Omniform
5929.desc: When this Pokemon uses a move whose type is mapped for its current form, it adapts mega-style into the mapped form before the move resolves: its stats and speed are recalculated and its other moves are replaced by the new form's set. The transform can chain and reverts after battle.

5930.name: Draconic Voodoo
5930.desc: On entry, the opposing Pokemon directly across gains Dragon as an additional type for the rest of the battle. Whenever this Pokemon damages a target with a biting or Dragon-type move, that target also gains Dragon. Never removes existing types.

5931.name: Hydrapex
5931.desc: When this Pokemon uses a single-target biting or Dragon-type move, two side heads each strike another Dragon-typed opponent at 35% power with no added effects. Inert when no other Dragon-typed opponent is present.

5932.name: Bad Splice
5932.desc: While this Pokemon is active, each opposing Pokemon is spliced with the types of one random living member of its own party, gaining them as additional types. The splice is removed when this Pokemon leaves the field.

5937.name: Genesis Supernova
5937.desc: This Pokemon's Psychic-type moves summon Psychic Terrain.

5939.name: Knight's Honor
5939.desc: Lowering any stats on its side raises Def and Sp. Def.

5963.name: Savage Spear
5963.desc: Horn moves hit twice. 1st hit at 100% power, 2nd hit at 40%.

5964.name: Grim Jab
5964.desc: Normal-type Drill moves become Ghost and deal 1.2x damage.

5965.name: Alluring Skull
5965.desc: Draws in Ghost moves, is immune to them, and raises its higher attacking stat.

5966.name: Formless Fist
5966.desc: Punching moves hit twice (2nd at 40%) and use its higher attacking stat.

5967.name: Prickly Armor
5967.desc: Deals 1/6 of an attacker's max HP on contact and takes 10% less damage from attacks.

5968.name: Shattered Psyche
5968.desc: Once per battle, after commands are chosen, this Pokemon fuses two of its opponents into one entity with their combined HP that takes both of their actions each turn. In a one-on-one battle it pulls a benched foe into the fusion instead. When the fused entity leaves the field, its remaining HP is split back between the two by their shares.

5969.name: Upcycle
5969.desc: All Pokemon on the field count as Food. With Sugar Rush, Poison-type targets take 2x damage instead of 1.5x.

5971.name: Eclipse Wing
5971.desc: Below one-third HP, Dark and Flying moves deal 1.5x damage. Once per battle, a direct hit that would knock this Pokemon out from full HP leaves it at 1 HP and triggers a 120-power Dark special counter. If that counter knocks out its target, this Pokemon faints at turn end.

5972.name: Final Season
5972.desc: On a voluntary switch-in, opposing Pokemon move last within their priority bracket for 2 turns. At that turn's end, this Pokemon sets Eerie Fog for 5 turns. During its own Eerie Fog, its Dark and Flying moves deal 1.3x damage.

5973.name: Foul Harvest
5973.desc: Once per move, a direct hit drains 1 PP from the foe's most recently used move and stores a charge, up to 3. Draining moves heal 25% more damage per stored charge, consume one charge, and restore 1 PP to that move.

5974.name: Porous
5974.desc: Takes half damage from sound moves. After taking a direct hit, its next Ground move gains 25% power, stacking up to 75%; the bonus is spent on use and resets on switch.

5975.name: Glam Rock
5975.desc: Cannot be forced out. At each turn's end, consumes one entry-hazard layer from its side and raises Defense and Sp. Def by 1.

5976.name: Sediment Bloom
5976.desc: When this Pokemon consumes or removes an entry hazard from its side, plants one removable Bloom on the opposing side. At turn end, Bloom drains 1/16 max HP from opposing Pokemon and heals this Pokemon's side by the amount drained.

5977.name: Two-Faced Unleashed
5977.desc: On alternating turns, damaging moves unleash this Pokemon: the move deals 1.5x damage, Electric and Dark moves deal a further 1.4x, and the user takes 15% nonlethal recoil. Cannot be copied, suppressed, or replaced.

5978.name: Skyhook
5978.desc: After this Pokemon directly damages a foe, it may pivot out once per turn. The incoming ally has a 20% chance to gain 1 Speed.

5979.name: Anneal
5979.desc: After being hit by a resisted move, raises Defense for a physical move or Sp. Def for a special move. Gains at most 2 stages per switch-in and triggers once per move.

5980.name: Living Chrome
5980.desc: The first 3 genuine transformations each battle grant Shape Memory for 1 turn: resist the types of the form just left. Leaving base Eevee instead grants 25% damage reduction. Shape Memory does not change typing or stack.

5981.name: Vapor Body
5981.desc: Contact moves used against this Pokemon have 0.7x accuracy. Contact-based trapping moves cannot trap it.

5982.name: Heavyweight
5982.desc: Weight-based and punching moves gain 10% power per favorable weight class, up to 50%. The first such hit each turn lowers the target's Defense by 1.

5983.name: Spirit Punch
5983.desc: Punching moves echo as a second Ghost hit at 30% power that ignores Defense boosts. The echo is 50% power if this Pokemon is Ghost-type, cannot crit, and cannot trigger on-KO effects.

5984.name: Deadeye Draw
5984.desc: Direct cannon or arrow damage marks one foe at a time. Cannon moves against the marked foe always critically hit and use its weaker defensive stat. The mark ends when either Pokemon leaves the field.

5985.name: Boot Hill
5985.desc: A direct knockout plants a one-use Grave Marker on the opposing side. The next foe entering takes 1/8 max HP Ghost damage and loses 1 Speed.

5987.name: Ring General
5987.desc: While above half HP, prevents opposing non-Ghost Pokemon without a Shed Shell from switching. Does not trap on the turn this Pokemon enters.

5988.name: Encore Set
5988.desc: After using a damaging move, the next different damaging move is followed by a 40%-power echo of the previous move against the same target. The echo cannot crit or trigger Encore Set.

5989.name: Setlist
5989.desc: Records its first 2 damaging moves after entry. Alternating between them then builds a crescendo: +20% power and +10% accuracy per step, up to +40% and +20%. Other moves reset it.

5990.name: Fan Favorite
5990.desc: Gains 5% accuracy and special damage per living benched party member, up to 25%. A bench Pokemon fainting removes its cheer immediately.

5991.name: Reduction
5991.desc: Before its next damaging move, consumes active non-primal weather and terrain. The move deals 1.5x damage and becomes dual-type; terrain determines the added type when both were consumed.

5992.name: Cracked Vessel
5992.desc: Once per battle, a direct hit that would knock this Pokemon out leaves it at 1 HP, sets Eerie Fog for 4 turns, badly poisons every adjacent battler except itself, and permanently removes its last type.

5993.name: Center of Attention
5993.desc: Spread moves deal 0.75x damage to this Pokemon even when only one target remains. A foe that damages one of this Pokemon's allies instead of it loses 1 Sp. Atk after the move.

5994.name: Superego
5994.desc: When a foe's stat stage rises above this Pokemon's corresponding stage, this Pokemon takes that boost and the foe is reset to this Pokemon's previous stage. Triggers once per stat each turn and ignores Egoist boosts.

5997.name: Meteor Mass
5997.desc: This Pokemon's weight is tripled. Its Heavy Slam and Heat Crash hit at their maximum weight ratio, and its weight-based and punching attacks grow stronger the heavier it is than the target. Its immense weight also makes Grass Knot and Low Kick hit it harder.

5998.name: Inverse Room
5998.desc: On entry, sets Inverse Room for 5 turns: type matchups are reversed across the field, so super effective becomes not very effective and immunities become weaknesses.
